snippet.text: theorem covariance_bounds (B N0 : ℕ) : (∀ i j, MeanClass strip 1 ((seed B N0).covariance i j)) ∧ (∀ i j, MeanClass strip (3/2 - ChartScales.kappa) ((seed B N0).covariance i j - ActualPrimaryCovariance.tangentCovariance B N0 i j)) — no hypotheses; its second clause is the curl-correction half, and matched_fluxes is literally `matched_fluxes_of_covariance B N0 (seed_covariance_smooth B N0) (tangent_covariance_smooth B N0) (covariance_bounds B N0).2` (line 590)
